name: adlc-skills
description: ADLC Skills: the Agentic Development Lifecycle as 40 skills, 23 commands and 2 agents across 8 plugins — from readiness and agent-ready specs to context engineering, agentic build, verification, governance, operations, and agent engineering.

plugins.name: adlc-foundations
plugins.description: ADLC foundations: readiness assessment on the DORA AI capabilities, SDLC-to-ADLC workflow mapping, agent autonomy levels, AI stance policy, ROI metrics, AI champions program, and role transitions.

plugins.name: adlc-intent
plugins.description: Intent specification for coding agents: Agentic PRDs, spec-driven development (constitution, spec, plan, tasks), testable acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then, EARS), spec clarification, and task decomposition.

plugins.name: adlc-context
plugins.description: Context engineering for coding agents: CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md authoring and audits, codebase maps, context-window budgeting, codifying conventions as skills, hooks or tests, MCP integration planning, and evidence-based skill library management.

plugins.name: adlc-build
plugins.description: Agentic construction at the system level: choosing and composing execution frameworks (Superpowers, Spec Kit, GSD, BMAD, built-in plan mode) with one owner per slot, small-batch delivery policy, and legacy modernization strategy with behavior parity.

plugins.name: adlc-verify
plugins.description: Verification of agent-built software: behavioral testing, tests derived from specs, alignment review of agent PRs, hallucination checks for APIs and dependencies, and a Definition of Done for agent work.

plugins.name: adlc-govern
plugins.description: Governance and security for agentic development: OWASP Agentic Top 10 threat modeling, least-privilege agent permissions, guardrail hooks, compliance mapping (ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act, SOC 2), and extension vetting.

plugins.name: adlc-operate
plugins.description: Operating the ADLC: release gates for agent-built changes, AgentOps observability, AI cost management and unit economics, and blameless agent incident reviews that feed durable fixes back into the lifecycle.

plugins.name: adlc-agent-engineering
plugins.description: Agent engineering for teams building AI agents and LLM features: architecture patterns, tool design, eval suites, prompts as versioned code, and runtime guardrails.
